title: What the Bel Canto Foundation was

story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: What was the Bel Canto Foundation?
It was a foundation to help dope addicts and alcoholics.
How did it function to do this?

Now that is something else. My lawyer said to me, "This is the strangest board I've ever seen. The president never has a board meeting or I don't know what she's doing. I think we all better leave her alone before we go to jail." The lawyer, Bill (Sousa(?)), terrific. Father Woods called him. He was a friend of Father Woods and he told him, "Please take care of Mary," and he has. He's done a lot of things he could charge me for and he's just never asked me for the money. He's gone to court and gotten me out of things, and some of my relatives. I'm sure I couldn't pay his price. I had a store front to raise money selling clothing.
